en-US: Show actionable diagnostics when mobile sign-in fails, making instance, network, and security-policy issues easier to resolve.
Allow attachments to be deleted safely from the asset library, with recoverable retries when storage cleanup is interrupted.
Route Android app upgrades through trusted Google Play or GitHub sources instead of requesting in-app package-install permission.
zh-CN: 移动端登录失败时显示可操作的诊断信息，帮助定位实例、网络与安全策略问题。
支持从附件库安全删除附件，并在存储清理中断时可靠重试。
Android 应用升级改为跳转 Google Play 或 GitHub 可信渠道，不再申请应用内安装软件包权限。
